Source Monster

Monster: Zorah Magdaros | CR: Event | Tier: 4

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

Release Bioenergy. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with this weapon, it dies as its life force seeps into the ground beneath it. The energy lingers in the space(s) for 1 minute or until absorbed. The following round after the dead creature's turn in the initiative order, another creature within the energy's area can use its bonus action to absorb the energy, regaining hit points equal to the slain creature's Challenge Rating or double its level. If more than one creature is in the energy's area, the hit points are split evenly between them when absorbed.

Armor Effect

While you are attuned to this armor, you can use your action to speak its command word to channel the power of Zorah Magdaros for 10 minutes, imbuing yourself with unparalleled endurance and surrounding yourself with molten rock. Until the effect ends, you cannot cast spells, but you gain the following benefits: You gain 50 temporary hit points. If any of these remain when the effect ends, they are lost. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these temporary hit points, the creature takes 25 fire damage. You have advantage on attack rolls that you make with simple and martial weapons. When you hit a target with a weapon attack, that target takes an extra 2d12 fire damage. You have proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throws. You can attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn. You ignore this benefit if you already have a feature, like Extra Attack, that gives you extra attacks.

description.chatFlavor: Channel Zorah Magdaros for 10 minutes (see description). Gain 50 temp HP; apply other benefits manually.
